title: Improvised Insulation
description: Explains how homes lose heat, then how to insulate windows, doors, and floors with blankets, bubble wrap, cardboard, and plastic sheeting and create a single warm room. Covers personal layering, sleeping warm, R-values of improvised materials, and insulating tents and vehicles overnight.
shortDescription: Insulate windows, doors, and floors with blankets, bubble wrap, and cardboard
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
